computeArchitecture.type: Host-Driven Compute (USB-C Tethered — no onboard SoC)
computeArchitecture.primarySoC: Hosted entirely on connected device (Smartphone / PC / MacBook / Steam Deck / ROG Ally)
computeArchitecture.eyewearCoprocessor: Onboard Sensor MCU (manages IMU, camera, wear detection, gesture pipeline locally on glasses)
computeArchitecture.audioCoprocessor: HARMAN AudioEFX DSP (spatial audio tuning built into glasses frame)
computeArchitecture.batteryCapacity: None — powered directly via USB-C tether from host device
computeArchitecture.tether: USB Type-C with magnetic pogo-pin connection (for secure, tool-free cable attach/detach)

displayAndOptics.opticsType: Birdbath Optics (folded reflective optical path for a compact form factor)
displayAndOptics.dimming: Electrochromic film adjustable tint (0.5% – 40% light transmission range)
displayAndOptics.visionCorrection: Built-in myopia diopter adjustment (up to -4.0D, no inserts needed)

connectivity.hostConnection: USB Type-C with magnetic pogo-pin (DP Alt Mode or USB display protocol)
connectivity.wireless: None (wired tether only — no onboard Wi-Fi or Bluetooth)

audio.microphones: Not specified — relies on host device microphone

sensorsAndTracking.wearDetection: Wear detection sensor (auto-on/off when donned or removed)
sensorsAndTracking.trackingDegreesOfFreedom: 6DoF tracking (requires SpaceWalker app or VITURE Pro Neckband for full 6DoF)
sensorsAndTracking.primaryInput: Bare-hand gesture recognition + 6DoF head motion tracking

softwareAndEcosystem.os: Host operating system (Android / macOS / Windows / Linux)
softwareAndEcosystem.spatialApp: SpaceWalker (VITURE's spatial window management app for compatible hosts)

simulationProfile.note: Slowest benchmark execution due to host-tethered compute model. The glasses have no internal SoC; all XR processing burden falls on the connected host device.
simulationProfile.ppdNote: Highest PPD in the simulated matrix at ~44.6 PPD. Excellent sub-pixel text legibility — no font scaling required.
